review_kind: Independent native Codex peer read-only review; not human approval or operational merge authorization
verdict: PASS within TF-200 scope; no material defect found

frozen_interfaces.CampaignRules_signatures: Seven exports match; strict TypeScript passed

source_check.edition: Knave 1.0 / first edition by Ben Milton / Questing Beast
source_check.method: Independently SHA-256 checked retained PDF and license, extracted PDF text with pdftotext and compared creation, saves, combat, damage, morale and healing; read retained source-grant evidence.
accurate_subset: Lowest of three d6; ability defense ten higher; optional pair swap
One starting d8 without Constitution addition
Strict d20 sum greater than target/defense; advantage high and disadvantage low
Constitution-defense item slots and unarmored defense11
Attacker Strength melee or Wisdom ranged; HP0 unconscious and negative dead
Ordinary d8 plus Constitution healing; morale2d6 holds on equality
changes_disclosed: Fixed Greek-myth kit, obol prices, supplies and equipment statistics
No optional low-HP reroll, XP or higher-level module
No player-facing defense rolls, critical damage, item-quality deterioration, ideal-weapon die or extra attack-plus-stunt
Daily rest timing and omission of full safe-haven heal
Original travel, retreat/pursuit, fall, finite project and bounded local taboo procedures
No spellbook/ritual engine or authority conferred by a preview
source_check.attribution: Author, edition, original source links, CC BY4.0 links/legal code, retained artifact identities, change notices and no-endorsement statement present. Existing source rights explicitly preserved without claiming a setting/repository-wide grant.
source_check.limit: No live author page fetch in this pass; retained PDF is a corroborated mirror, accurately not described as author-checksum-authenticated.

implementation_review: No RNG invocation, I/O or canonical writer in calculator bodies; caller supplies dice; only seven named pure preview exports.
Passive descriptor traversal rejects proxies before traps, accessors, exotic prototypes, symbols, hidden properties, sparse/decorated arrays and cycles; finite traversal bounds are implemented.
Closed field sets, safe integer and negative-zero refusal, range checks, intermediate overflow refusal and exact dice counts match frozen contract.
No caller mutation; output consists of fresh primitive-valued objects; no internal mutable result reference escapes.
Strict success and morale equality boundaries differ deliberately and correctly; rest rejects negative HP; projects conserve finite resources and cannot overshoot.
tabletop_review: Level-one creation is concrete; starting allowance sums to9slots or10with spear, within minimum Constitution defense11; gear hands/capacity and purchases are specified.

Combat specifies side initiative each round, movement/action budget, melee/ranged requirements, strict hits, weapon damage, zero/negative consequences, stunts, retreat/pursuit and optional mortal templates.
Exploration/travel durations, two-watch normal travel, forced march, daily food/water, fuel/ammunition, finite foraging, casualty transport and checkpoint handling are actionable.
Eight-hour supplied safe rest and one healing roll per24hours prevent repeated-nap recovery; zeroHP can survive/rest and negativeHP cannot resurrect.
Sheet matches rules and records slots, supplies, rest allowance, personal knowledge and observer-owned impressions; no universal reputation/virtue score.
Dark tragic mythic tone is explicit; particular divine punishments are bounded and signposted; Fates have no combat blocks or virtue-court role.

Informed actual time-gift consent remains separate from charisma, oaths, prices, character creation and calculator results; tabletop death is not end_thread and no ordinary action creates the anomaly.

independent_properties.scope: Exhaustive small ability/check/damage/project domains plus passive-input, depth/budget and safe-integer boundary probes
